fixedStars.horosaBehavior: perchart.getFixedStars and getStars call flatlib chart.getFixedStars, which calls swe.fixstar_ut for const.LIST_FIXED_STARS.
fixedStars.names: Horosa ids in LIST_FIXED_STARS; display names from const.STAR_NAMES, else the catalog id.

subset.duplicate: STAR_UNUKALHAI is listed twice. The cache comment says 67.

catalog.data: Swiss fixed-star catalog used for chart longitude
catalog.openedBy: flatlib sets the ephemeris path to resources/swefiles. swe_fixstar_ut reads sefstars.txt. ephem.py names that file.
recordFields: proper motion RA in 0.001 arcsec/year times cos(decl)
catalog.epoch: Per record: 1950, 2000, or ICRS. EPOCH_RULE is the record field, not a Horosa-wide J2000 default.
catalog.referenceFrame: The equinox field of each catalog record.
catalog.zodiac: Output longitude follows the chart flags: tropical by default, sidereal when applySiderealMode is on.
catalog.precession: Swiss swe_fixstar_ut moves the catalog position to the chart Julian day. Horosa does not apply its own precession on this path.
catalog.precision: Catalog RA and Dec are stored as hours or degrees, minutes, and seconds. Output lon, lat, ra, and decl are the floats returned by fixstar_ut. Magnitude comes from fixstar_mag.
catalog.displayedLongitude: sweFixedStar lon at the chart JD. A southern chart then adds 180 degrees in perchart.relocateSouthObjects. The 1990 golden latitude is north, so that shift is off.
catalog.conjunction: getStars keeps a star when the shortest ecliptic separation is strictly less than the orb. Default orb is 1 degree.
catalog.experimentCatalog: MISSING in experiments/phase4d-sweph-wasm. The wasm package has no sefstars file.

siblingFilesNotSubstituted.note: Same directory. Swiss opens sefstars.txt, not this name.
swe.py says fixstar_mag parses fixstars.cat. Positions stay on sefstars.txt.

electionTable.precession: PRECESSION_ARCSEC_PER_YEAR = 50.27 in that file. This is not swe_fixstar_ut.

qizhengKinNotChartPath.citation: File comment names BahnAstro/MOIRA_chinese_astrology. No URL and no license sentence in the file.

nakshatra.zeroPoint: 0 degrees of the sidereal longitude passed in. The function does not name Lahiri.
nakshatra.ayanamsaSource: The chart object longitude. perchart.getChartObj calls nakshatra_from_lon only when zodiacal is sidereal. Empty siderealAyanamsa follows the Swiss Ephemeris current default, recorded in perchart, not inside nakshatra.py.
nakshatra.rounding: index = min(26, int(normalizedLongitude / span)). An exact boundary belongs to the next mansion.

guoStarSect.placement: perchart.setupPlanets writes planet.su from TERM_SU27 using the planet sign and sign longitude.
guoStarSect.dayNight: The Moon mansion is lifesu. Relations in LIST_SU_RELATION are counted from that mansion. There is no separate day-chart and night-chart mansion table in this function.
guoStarSect.epoch: Static degrees inside each sign. The sign itself follows the chart zodiac.
guoStarSect.license: No separate license header in guotables.py. In-repo source.
